## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pull the dark gray microwave open with the left arm.

The dark gray microwave at the rear of the table has its door closed. The task is to pull the door open with the left arm.

Success criteria: Use the left arm to open the oven door to 60% or more of its maximum travel. Pulling it open only a crack does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Grip the middle of the vertical handle on the oven door's front right, avoiding upper and lower joints. Surround it from left and right with an opening slightly wider than the handle to reduce contact with the door panel or mounts.
- Before closing, use the side view to confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides of the handle and the pads contact the part that protrudes from the door. Avoid visual overlap without actually enclosing it.
- Move the end effector along the door's actual arc as you pull, adjusting its orientation and maintaining grasp height. Avoid continually pulling along a fixed straight line, which can cause slipping or jamming.
- Use the space in front of the oven door when approaching its handle with the left arm. Make major wrist adjustments away from the door and clutter. Leave clearance around the tall can, packaging, and front-left white object to reduce sweeping collisions from the arm or outward-swinging door.
